subject: 3-Way Tie
author: dadditude
body:
Although I voted for Hunter, I also like Carson and Krieger. The reasons these are my favorites? Road Rage events are my favorites, and The cars I have used most in Road Rage were (in this order):

  1. Krieger Pioneer
  2. Carson Inferno Van
  3. Hunter Takedown 4 x 4

Although I do wish the 4 x 4 had better handling. :(

body: the Krieger PCPD Special is AWESOME!!  Actually, all of the Krieger WTR cars rock.  I just love the responsiveness.  Weaving thru traffic is a dream in these cars...

subject: Krieger PCPD Special
author: Xandu
body:
My favourite car so far is the Krieger PCPD Special. It only has a 9 in speed rating but the 2 in strength and 10 in boost makes this an amazing car. The handling is very precise and makes it ideal for last second direction changes at high speed. This bad boy sounds, looks and handles like a F1 car... not that I have ever driven a real one... 😃

-- The Creator --
